basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old software developer based in Austin, Texas. I spend my days coding in Haskell and exploring functional programming paradigms. I'm particularly interested in educational content, especially anything that challenges my problem-solving skills. Outside of work, I'm an avid gamer with a soft spot for indie titles and enjoy discussing game mechanics and design. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm in a long-term relationship and my partner shares my love for technology and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the field for the past five years. My expertise lies in functional programming, and I've taught myself Haskell through online courses and community projects. I often participate in programming forums and have contributed to open-source projects.
